subject: DPIA & audit access — pathways, sampling plan, and Art.28/30 artifacts
body:
From: Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@almahealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Berger <tberger@almahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPIA support + audit access questions (AlmaHealth)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of our onboarding we need to close a few items for our internal DPIA and audit committee:

- Confirmation of the evidence packages you can provide for Art.28 / Art.30 (processing records, subprocessor list, KMS wrap docs).
- A proposed remote review pathway (live session vs ledger extract + redaction).
- A sampling approach for operational logs (we typically require a 3-month window; looking for sampling rules and expected lead time).

Attached is our DPIA questionnaire (PDF). Can you confirm what you can provide within two weeks? Also cc'ed Tom from security — he may have follow-ups on redaction requirements.

Best,
Lena
Head of Compliance
AlmaHealth Systems

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@almahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPIA support + audit access questions (AlmaHealth)

Hi Lena — thanks for sending this over and for the meeting yesterday. 

Short answer: we can provide an Art.28/30 artifact pack and support a hybrid remote review. Details below and we"ll loop in the right owners.

What we can deliver within 10 business days (standard package):
- Article 30 register extract (CSV) with processing categories, purposes, retention codes.
- Subprocessor inventory snapshot with contract dates and SCC status.
- KMS wrap summary and key rotation timeline (redacted key material).
- Sample access logs (audit log extracts) for the requested period; full logs require a sampling plan and redaction approval.

Options for remote review:
1) Ledger extract + redaction (fastest): we produce CSV extracts and apply agreed redaction rules; you review in secure Drive.
2) Live remote walkthrough: we host a session and share masked console screens; suitable for deeper validation.
3) Combined: provide extracts plus a scheduled 90-minute walkthrough for clarifications.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa will propose a timeline and DocuSign for an evidence access annex to the DPA (covers scope, lead times, redaction SLA).
- Karthik and Priyom will draft a sampling plan and a list of artifacts we need to produce (Karthik: technical; Priyom: ops).

Can you confirm your preferred pathway (ledger extract vs live walkthrough) and an initial 3-month window you want sampled?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Privacy Operations | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0176

---

On Thu, Apr 5, 2028 at 11:25 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
> To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
> Cc: Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@almahealth.com>
> Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 11:25:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: DPIA support + audit access questions (AlmaHealth)
>
> Hi all,
>
> Quick technical notes for the artifact pack and sampling rules:
>
> - Article 30: we can provide a machine-exportable register with fields mapped to the standard (controller/processor roles, categories, legal basis, recipients). Export will be CSV + a human-readable PDF narrative.
>
> - Subprocessor list: snapshot (date-stamped) + SCC status. For long-term processors we include contract start/end and whether data access is production or dev.
>
> - Access logs: recommended sampling approach: rolling 3-month window, stratified sample by route (API keys, console actions, infra tooling), target ~1% of events with emphasis on high-risk routes (model export, dataset download). This balances signal and scope.
>
> - Redaction: we can apply token-level redaction and hash pseudonymisation for identifiers; full personal data redaction will be performed before extracts leave our environment. We need a short redaction rulesheet signed off by the customer.
>
> - Lead times: register + subprocessor snapshot: 3 business days. Configured log extracts with redaction: 7-10 business days (depends on window size). Live walkthroughs: available 2-3 weeks out.
>
> I"ll prepare the access_matrix_template.csv (for internal mapping) and the redaction guidelines draft.
>
> —Karthik
> Senior Platform Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
> karthik_iyer@redwood.com
>
---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@almahealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPIA support + audit access questions (AlmaHealth)

Thanks Lena — happy to coordinate timeline and contracting. 

Proposed plan from a commercial/ops perspective:
- Sign evidence access annex (7 business days turnaround on our end). I"ve attached a one-page annex draft (DocuSign link above) covering scope, redaction SLAs, and the remote review process.
- Target dates: initial artifact delivery (register + subprocessor snapshot) by 2028-04-13, log extracts (sampled & redacted) by 2028-04-20. Live walkthrough the week of 2028-04-24 if needed.
- Out-of-scope unless agreed: full raw logs or production plaintext exports containing direct identifiers.

If AlmaHealth confirms the ledger-extract path and signs the annex, we"ll start the extracts on 2028-04-10.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---

On Fri, 6 Apr 2028 16:40:00 -0700, Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@almahealth.com> wrote:
> From: Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@almahealth.com>
> To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
> Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
> Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 16:40:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: DPIA support + audit access questions (AlmaHealth)
>
> Hi team — thanks for the clear options and timelines. AlmaHealth confirms the ledger-extract + redaction route. We reviewed the draft redaction guidelines and have two quick asks:
>
> 1) Can Redwood provide a hashed identifier column so we can correlate events without receiving PII?
> 2) We need a written confirmation that exports will never contain unredacted patient identifiers; can that be added to the annex as an SLA?
>
> We will sign the annex once the two items above are reflected (tracking via the DocuSign link). Happy to proceed with the dates Marissa proposed.
>
> Best,
> Lena
> Head of Compliance | AlmaHealth Systems
> lena.hoffman@almahealth.com

---

Notes/Action items (internal):
- Priyom: prepare the sampling job and redaction pipeline; scope for 3-month window, ~1% stratified sample. Deliver by 2028-04-10. (attachment: access_matrix_template.csv)
- Karthik: produce Article 30 export and KMS summary; provide redaction guidance and hashed-identifier scheme. Deliver by 2028-04-13.
- Marissa: finalize annex including the explicit non-PII SLA and send DocuSign; confirm start date for extracts.
- Naomi: monitor and provide cover note for register and subprocessor snapshot.

Attachments referenced: Alma_DPIA_questionnaire_20280402.pdf; redaction_guidelines_v1.docx; access_matrix_template.csv
